reviewer: Implementation agent, actual LLM image viewing
reasons: Viewed all 42 panels after correction: original plus six generated phases in two compositions, at native, half and 4x scales.
Fixed rim and surrounding pole/background preserved; no soft glow. Thin steam rises and disperses with common baseline.
Opacity 0.4 selected after actual viewing of 0.25/0.4/0.55 comparison; quiet but clearer than 0.25.
All 36 phase panels have zero changed RGBA outside the safe region and at/below rim.
limitations: Native steam consists of few pixels and is subtle. Some half-scale phases have no surviving pixels; half-scale motion is not clearly discernible.
Static QA plus pure timing boundaries does not replace long continuous viewing on actual devices.
